items.title: Panel formed to conduct PNDA has six weeks to prepare report
items.blurb: A Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment estimates damage caused by the August 26 flood at Rs400 billion.

items.title: Late rescues renew hope for survivors in deadly Nepal floods
items.blurb: A 64-year-old woman was rescued alive from beneath her buried home as her family performed her death rites, while three others—including a Chinese national—were pulled alive from hydropower tunnels in Rasuwa.

items.title: Flood-displaced mothers struggle for privacy and care
items.blurb: In crowded shelters, pregnant women and new mothers are struggling for privacy, adequate food and access to maternity care as damaged roads cut them off from hospitals.

items.title: Floods revive questions over an abandoned mountain airstrip
items.blurb: Langtang airport sits at an elevation of 3,658 metres above sea level.

items.title: Two killed in landslide at Super Seti hydropower project
items.blurb: Workers were digging a road at the under-construction project in Kaski when a landslide struck the site on Saturday.

items.title: Nepal wants to be a clean-energy powerhouse. The indigenous people are paying the price
items.blurb: A hydropower boom backed by billions in financing is colliding with local communities who say they were never really asked.

items.title: Security personnel install Nepali flag on the border with China in Rasuwagadhi
items.blurb: With the entire settlement at the bordering town swept away by last week’s devastating floods, there was nothing that separated the Nepali territory from that of China in Rasuwagadhi.

items.title: Two people rescued alive on 11th day after floods
items.blurb: A Chinese national was pulled from a hydropower tunnel in Rasuwa, while a 64-year-old woman was rescued from the upper floor of a house in Nuwakot.

items.title: Woman rescued alive after 10 days trapped in debris-buried house
items.blurb: Armed Police Force team pulls 64-year-old Chandika Kumari Shrestha from the upper floor of a four-storey building in Betrawati.

items.title: Where rescue efforts stand at flood-hit hydropower projects
items.blurb: Two workers have been rescued, and bodies recovered, but teams are still searching flooded tunnels and damaged sites for hundreds of missing people.

items.title: Chinese national pulled alive from hydropower tunnel in Nepal after 10 days
items.blurb: Luhaitao was found about 225 metres inside the Upper Trishuli-1 tunnel as Nepali and foreign rescuers continued searching the site.

items.title: NEPSE falls as flood concerns weigh on insurance, hydropower
items.blurb: The index slips 0.57 percent in a four-session week, erasing about Rs30 billion in market value as thin trading and weak momentum keep the market near key support.

items.title: Nepal flood death toll reaches 1,342
items.blurb: Police say 4,886 people remain missing and 1,030 bodies have been buried as search operations continue.

items.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah to address UN General Assembly on September 24
items.blurb: His first foreign trip since taking office comes as Nepal seeks international support after devastating floods.

items.title: 27 US lawmakers urge Rubio to expand rescue, aid efforts in Nepal
items.blurb: Lawmakers call for US disaster response team, high-altitude search assets and faster assistance as thousands remain missing.

items.title: Where to support flood relief in Kathmandu this week and beyond
items.blurb: From charity runs to creative workshops, these events offer ways to support flood-affected communities.

items.title: They stopped hoping to find him alive. Then they found a hand
items.blurb: Raj Kumar Diyali went missing with his wife and four-year-old son in Nepal’s Bhotekoshi flood. His family is now waiting for DNA confirmation.

items.title: Barely saved, he cuts mourning short to help flood survivors
items.blurb: Sudip Kumar Neupane watched a raging Trishuli swallow his younger brother and a close colleague, then came out of grief after two days.

items.title: Can Nepal turn Himalayan vulnerability into a case for compensation?
items.blurb: The Bhotekoshi disaster highlights rising climate risks in the Himalayas, but experts say Nepal needs stronger evidence, sharper diplomacy and a clear strategy to secure international grants.

items.title: After nine days in darkness, two men walked back into the light
items.blurb: Rescuers pulled Sanjay Sah and Kabir Maharjan alive from the Trishuli 3A hydropower tunnel after more than 72 hours of painstaking search, but dozens of people remain unaccounted for.
